priorExposure: Fixed Gate results and previous anatomy have been viewed. This is a post-hoc descriptive coverage diagnostic, never a new confirmatory result.
targets: All 9 lane-USABLE verdicts and all 23 calibration-only lane-WATCH verdicts; no promotion or Gate changes
confidenceMeaning: Sampling-precision policy for stored estimates, NOT calibrated probability, symbol-specific temporal reliability, or trading readiness
referenceScale: Population SD (ddof=0) of frozen A peer-relative values for the same lane/trait; zero or absent => normalized uncertainty unknown

MEDIUM.drift: true prohibited; unknown allowed with explicit warning

LOW: Finite eligible stored posterior, but HIGH/MEDIUM unmet; no fallback to a different window
INSUFFICIENT: No eligible finite posterior/uncertainty/peer prediction. A prior is not fabricated when no saved prior exists.
episodes: Use stored event-bearing session counts for conditional traits only; individual intraday episode counts unavailable. For unconditional rates also derive positive sessions as raw rate*nSessions, explicitly NOT episodes.
peerDifferentiation: abs(posterior-peer_prediction)>1.96*posterior_sd, in transformed units; conditional on fitted prior, exploratory/unadjusted, not a symbol-level significance certificate
stratification: Reconstruct A mean logVa/logS/logPrice/coverage from saved peer prediction linear identities, standardized coefficients, mu and SD. Require >=6 equations, identifiable coordinates, condition<=1e8, held-out equation residual<=1e-8*(1+abs(prediction)); unavailable coordinates UNKNOWN. Verify logVa against saved trading_value transformedA when available. A-only tertiles pooled per lane, ties deterministic; strata are historical A, not current snapshot covariates. No raw payloads opened.
signStability: Report saved global incremental/reverse direction; per-symbol A/B raw-centered sign agreement descriptive only because B peer predictions are not saved. Window residual signs compare overlapping snapshots only, not independent stability.
integration: Code union and intersection reported. Dedupe same trait across lanes for count; keep both records/provenance. Any simultaneous handoff requires matched computed_through, both independently valid, same definition/units, fresh Reader. Different lane endpoints imply no certified joint current profile. Never carry old daily values silently forward.
representatives: Primary60 intraday PDH: lowest code in each HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INSUFFICIENT category present, then lowest code at min/median/max usable H+M count; remove duplicates. No return/outcome-based selection.
sparseDispatch: Dry contract only. Only global USABLE plus HIGH/MEDIUM may enter candidate payload; WATCH excluded regardless of confidence. Current interface-ready=false globally. No Entry/EXIT trials.
fixedSafety: All existing nine Safety flags false; historical research only; no production/PIT/OOS claim
stop: After tests, full regression, deterministic regeneration, CI, Evidence, visualization and handoff
